entries.source:
As you enter Last Hope a courier finds you to deliver a letter from Protector Myssil of Zigur:

%s, while you were away destroying arcane filth I have received grave news.
A group of Krogs has been ambushed and taken to a hidden ruin on the eastern shores of the sea of Sash near Zigur.
From what the scouts can tell they were taken by a group of necromancers, probably to do vile experiments on them.

All our other elite fighting forces are currently abroad, you are their only hope.
Please, go there at once, free them and show the necromancers filth the True Wrath of the Ziguranth!

#{italic}#Protector Myssil#{normal}#
entries.target:
当你进入最后的希望时，一个信使找到你并给你一份来自伊格的守护者米歇尔的信：

%s，当你在外面打击肮脏的奥术势力时，我收到了一个令人震惊的消息。
一群克罗格遭到伏击并被带到伊格附近的萨希之海东岸一处隐藏的废墟中。
侦察员看见他们被一群死灵法师带走，可能会对他们进行邪恶的实验。

我们其他所有的精英部队都在外面，你是他们唯一的希望。
请立刻去那里解救他们，并让死灵法师见识一下伊格兰斯真正的愤怒！

#{italic}#守护者米歇尔#{normal}#

entries.source: Made Nektosh use up the last of his power, then left the area and ignored him until beating the game. The other Whitehooves will catch on any second now...
entries.target: 让纳克托什用尽能量，然后离开区域并无视他，直到通关为止。其他白蹄族成员随时都会察觉真相……

entries.source: Destroyed the Sunwall Outpost to secure a way to the mainland.
entries.target: 消灭太阳堡垒前哨站，以确保通往大陆的道路。

entries.source: Freed the remnants of the Prides from the Internment Camp.
entries.target: 释放拘留营中的部落成员。

entries.source: Crushed High Sun Paladin Aeryn and with her destroyed the bastion of the Sunwall.
entries.target: 杀死高阶太阳骑士艾琳，并摧毁太阳堡垒的要塞。

entries.source: The Palace of Fumes stands in ruins, its Council shattered. The Atmos Tribe will not bother the Prides anymore.
entries.target: 烟雾宫殿被摧毁，议会分崩离析。气之部族不再威胁各兽人部落。

entries.source: You have defeated the Sher'tul Priest trying to resurrect Amakthel, saving both the Prides and the world.
entries.target: 你消灭了试图复活阿马克泰尔的夏·图尔牧师，拯救了部落和世界。

entries.source: You have destroyed the last remnants of the Atmos Tribe, ending their civilization.
entries.target: 你消灭了气之部族的最后成员，终结了他们的文明。

entries.source: You have spared the last remnants of the Atmos Tribe, showing mercy where others gave none to the orcs.
entries.target: 你拯救了气之部族的最后成员，展现了兽人未曾得到的仁慈。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Magic and Constitution
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：魔力和体质。
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +0 力量，+0 敏捷，+3 体质
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +6 魔力，+0 意志，+0 灵巧

entries.source: Tinkers use steamtech to power their attacks, defenses, ...
entries.target: 工匠们使用蒸汽科技来强化攻击、防御，……

entries.source: Build, experiment, discover. The path of inventions is never over!
entries.target: 制造、实验、发现。创造之路永无止境！

entries.source: A formidable behemoth of war using steamsaws to improve his deadliness.
entries.target: 可怕的战争巨兽，使用蒸汽链锯增加致命杀伤力。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Strength and Cunning
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：力量和灵巧
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +5 力量，+0 敏捷，+1 体质
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +0 魔力，+0 意志，+3 灵巧

entries.source: A tinker who dual-wields steamguns to great effect.
Their most important stats are: Cunning and Dexterity
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：灵巧和敏捷
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +0 力量，+4 敏捷，+1 体质
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +0 魔力，+0 意志，+4 灵巧

entries.source: Bend the mind, bend the tech. All around inspire dread.
entries.target: 扭曲精神，扭曲科技，一切都是为了激发恐惧。

entries.source: Powerful psionics are able to enter a gestalt with steam generators and technology to enhance their own mental prowess.
entries.target: 强大的灵能使用者能够与蒸汽发生器和科技形成格式塔联结，以增强自身的精神力量。

entries.source: The Psyshot combines this ability to gestalt to enhance his mindstar all the while shooting her steamgun to devastate the enemy lines.
entries.target: 灵能射手将这项能力与格式塔结合，来强化灵晶的力量，同时使用蒸汽枪毁灭敌人。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Cunning, Willpower and Dexterity
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：灵巧、意志和敏捷
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +0 力量，+3 敏捷，+0 体质
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +0 魔力，+3 意志，+3 灵巧

entries.source: The Annihilator is a master of destruction, wielding the most devastating steamtech inventions to lay waste to their foes.
entries.target: 歼灭者是破坏的大师，他们掌握着最具破坏力的蒸汽科技成果，可以给他们的敌人带来无尽的毁灭。

entries.source: While normally wielding a steamgun loaded with experimental ammunition and an electrically charged shield, they can equip heavy weapons such as flamethrowers.
entries.target: 他们通常手持装填了实验性弹药的蒸汽枪和一面电力充能的盾牌，但他们也可以装备像火焰喷射器那样的重装武器。

entries.source: More adept at technology than most other tinkers, they supplement their weapons with automated turrets, mechanical minions and other such devices.
entries.target: 他们比其他的工匠更加精通科学技术，他们使用自动炮台、机械随从和各种各样的强大发明来充实自己的武器库。
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +0 力量，+4 敏捷，+0 体质
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +0 魔力，+0 意志，+5 灵巧

entries.source: Orcs have a long and sad history. They are seen, and are, as an aggressive race that more than one time managed to imperil all of Maj'Eyal.
entries.target: 兽人拥有久远而悲伤的历史。他们被视为（也确实如此）一个侵略性种族，曾不止一次危及整个马基埃亚尔世界。

entries.source: But one year ago the Scourge from the West came and wiped four of the five Prides. And a hundred years ago King Toknor wiped all traces of orcs from Maj'Eyal.
entries.target: 但是一年前，来自西方的天灾消灭了五个兽人部落中的四个。一百年前，图库纳国王消灭了马基埃亚尔本土的所有兽人。

entries.source: The orc race is dangerously on the brink of destruction. One wrong move is all that is needed.
entries.target: 兽人种族正危险地处于毁灭边缘。只需走错一步，就足以令其毁灭。

entries.source: But they are strong and will face whatever is needed to ensure a future of their own!
entries.target: 但他们意志强大，敢于直面任何磨难，来创造属于他们的未来！
